All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Transferring intellectual property upon delivery means the client receives full ownership before paying, removing your financial leverage if payment is delayed under Net 30 terms.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: This allows the client to walk away immediately without notice and without paying for completed work or incurred expenses, resulting in uncompensated labor.
findings.suggested_change: Client may terminate this Agreement upon 15 days written notice and shall pay Contractor for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the termination date.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello! Thank you for sharing the agreement. I look forward to working together and have two small points to discuss before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, transferring rights upon delivery means the client receives full ownership before paying, which removes financial leverage if payment is delayed; I propose that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable. - Regarding the relevant clause on termination, allowing termination at any time without notice or further payment creates the risk of uncompensated labor; I propose that Client may terminate this Agreement upon 15 days written notice and shall pay Contractor for all services performed and expenses incurred up to the termination date. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you. Best regards,
